source: M031 validation plus M033 S01 baseline planning

boundaries.why: A requested ref without a safe catalog row must not silently advance into acquisition.
boundaries.external_parser_implication: External tools cannot repair catalog identity gaps; they need a selected local source or typed blocker.

boundaries.why: Acquisition must prove safe local artifacts with hashes and sizes before loader/parser work.
boundaries.external_parser_implication: OpenDataLoader/GROBID probes should use local PDFs with sha256 and no network fetch by default.

boundaries.why: Only captured local artifacts should become loaded candidates; non-captured rows stay blocked.
boundaries.external_parser_implication: Parser probes must preserve which rows were actually loadable versus metadata-only controls.

boundaries.why: Non-empty markdown or HTTP/PDF success is insufficient; usable body text and source quality must be checked.
boundaries.external_parser_implication: External parser output must be judged for reading order, body substance, section structure, and diagnostic clarity.

boundaries.why: Chunking only follows parser-ready converted artifacts with stable source linkage.
boundaries.external_parser_implication: Layout/table outputs must map to source spans before they can influence chunk/evidence contracts.

boundaries.why: Reviewer packets are not import eligibility without independent completed review.
boundaries.external_parser_implication: OpenDataLoader/GROBID artifacts can at most create candidate reviewer inputs in M033.

boundaries.why: M031 established a no-write import rehearsal; parser improvements do not authorize LadybugDB writes.
boundaries.external_parser_implication: All M033 artifacts must keep production import and LadybugDB write flags false.

forbidden_positive_claims: parser output is graph-ready by default
evaluation_rule: Classify failures as implementation defects, formal artifact conflicts, requirement framing issues, or validation policy issues before changing code.
